'''2011 Texas Mini Worlds Day 1 Todd Benard DS No Money, No Parts, No Deal!''' was the Dark Side constructed list played by [[Todd Benard]] at [[2011 Texas Mini Worlds]] (Day 1).

== Deck info ==

* '''Starting Card:''' {{CardLink|No Money, No Parts, No Deal! / You're A Slave?|Cor-D-nomoneynopartsnodeal.gif}}
* '''Name on sheet:''' Todd
* '''Username:''' Barnard
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Virtual Block 7.2]]
* '''Stage:''' Day 1
